the-abbot: The sequel to Scott's The Monastery follows young Roland Graeme into the heart of Scotland's troubles: the imprisonment of Mary Queen of Scots at Lochleven Castle. As her page, he is swept into plots, escapes, and divided loyalties. Scott blends real history with romantic adventure, bringing the tragic queen's story vividly to life.
lineage-life-and-labors-of-jose-rizal-ph: Austin Craig's biography honors José Rizal — novelist, reformer, and martyr of Philippine independence. From his brilliant youth to his execution in 1896, Rizal's life unfolds as the story of a nation's awakening. A tribute to Southeast Asia's great hero of freedom.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-abbot: This 1913 reference article on the abbot — the father and ruler of a monastery — sets out his election, rights, and duties. Thomas Oestereich writes with church-law precision. Mitred abbots ranked with bishops of old. A clear guide to monastic rule.
